topic: Hidden detail: Wado Ichimonji, Shusui and Enma all come from Wano, and Oda tied Zoro's village to Wano hundreds of chapters before the arc
title: Zoro's Swords All Trace Back To Wano's Samurai
description: Zoro's three most important swords all came from Wano, including the one he carried out of the East Blue. Here's my read on how Oda tied Shimotsuki Village to Wano long before the arc arrived. Coincidence or plan?
comment: Is Zoro's Wano connection planned from chapter 1, or just Oda recycling a sword country? Pick one.

lines.text: Zoro's three most important swords all came from Wano.

shot.fallback: green haired swordsman with three swords

lines.text: Even the one he carried out of the East Blue.

shot.fallback: swordsman holding a white scabbard sword

lines.text: Start with Wado Ichimonji, Kuina's sword, the one Zoro promised to carry to the top.

shot.fallback: young swordsman girl and boy with wooden swords

lines.text: It was Shimotsuki Kozaburo who brought it from Wano and founded Shimotsuki Village.

shot.fallback: old swordsmith with a katana in a dojo

lines.text: Then in Wano, Zoro fights the samurai Ryuma and walks away with Shusui.
Here's what most people missed. Ryuma's full name is Shimotsuki Ryuma.

shot.fallback: legendary samurai with a long black sword

lines.text: Same family name as Zoro's hometown.

shot.fallback: seaside village with a sword dojo

lines.text: Finally, Enma, Oden's old blade, which Hiyori hands Zoro to replace Shusui.

shot.fallback: princess handing a legendary sword to a swordsman

lines.text: Three swords, one country, and Zoro never planned any of it.

shot.fallback: swordsman standing before cherry blossoms and a castle

lines.text: People say Wano is just where great swords come from.

shot.fallback: samurai country with towering castle and blades

lines.text: Maybe. But Zoro's village got its name hundreds of chapters before Wano arrived.

shot.fallback: small seaside village with a dojo

lines.text: So my read is Oda planted Wano in Zoro from the very start.

shot.fallback: swordsman looking at a distant island

lines.text: Zoro isn't collecting Wano's swords. He's inheriting its swordsmanship.

shot.fallback: swordsman using three sword style with black lightning

lines.text: And that's why I think Zoro's three most important swords all came from Wano...

shot.fallback: green haired swordsman with three swords
